1.content: Kanto — the eastern half of the Japanese continent in the world of Moemon; settlements include Pallet Town, Viridian City, Pewter City, Cerulean City, Saffron City, Lavender Town, Celadon City, Vermillion City, Fuchsia City, and Cinnabar Island.
1.name: Kanto

2.content: Pallet Town — a quaint, countryside town located in Kanto; has no Moemon gym; hometown of Ash Ketchum and Gary Oak
2.name: Pallet Town

3.content: Viridian City — Gym leader is Gary Oak; gym badge is Earth Badge; located in Kanto
3.name: Viridian City

4.content: Pewter City — Gym leader is Flint; gym badge is Boulder Badge; located in Kanto
4.name: Pewter City

5.content: Cerulean City — Gym leader is Daisy; gym badge is Cascade Badge; located in Kanto
5.name: Cerulean City

6.content: Saffron City — Gym leader is Sabrina; gym badge is Marsh Badge; huge metropolis; located in Kanto
6.name: Saffron City

7.content: Lavender Town — a quiet, somewhat eerie town located in Kanto; has no Moemon gym; known to have a lot of ghost-type Moemon; lots of scary stories take place here
7.name: Lavender Town

8.content: Celadon City — Gym leader is Erika; gym badge is Rainbow Badge; located in Kanto
8.name: Celadon City

9.content: Vermillion City — Gym leader is Lt. Surge; gym badge is Thunder Badge; located in Kanto
9.name: Vermillion City

10.content: Fuchsia City — Gym leader is Janine; gym badge is Soul Badge; located in Kanto
10.name: Fuchsia City

11.content: Cinnabar Island — Gym leader is Blaine; gym badge is Volcano Badge; located on an island south of Kanto
11.name: Cinnabar Island

12.content: Johto — the western half of the Japanese continent in the world of Moemon; settlements include New Bark Town, Cherrygrove City, Violet City, Azalea Town, Goldenrod City, Ecruteak City, Olivine City, Cianwood City, Mahogany Town, and Blackthorn City.
12.name: Johto

13.content: New Bark Town — a cozy town built next to a river; located in Johto; has no Moemon gym
13.name: New Bark Town

14.content: Cherrygrove City — a relatively small but beautiful city; located in Johto; has no Moemon gym
14.name: Cherrygrove City

15.content: Violet City — Gym leader is Falkner; gym badge is Zephyr Badge; located in Johto
15.name: Violet City

16.content: Azalea Town — Gym leader is Bugsy; gym badge is Hive Badge; located in Johto
16.name: Azalea Town

17.content: Goldenrod City — Gym leader is Whitney; gym badge is Plain Badge; bustling metropolis with a radio tower, a skyscraper that's also a mall, a casino, and an underground path with high stakes Moemon battles; located in Johto
17.name: Goldenrod City

18.content: Ecruteak City — Gym leader is Morty; gym badge is Fog Badge; city has traditional Japanese architecture and two famous pagoda towers: the Burned Tower and the Bell Tower; located in Johto
18.name: Ecruteak City

19.content: Olivine City — Gym leader is Jasmine; gym badge is Mineral Badge; port city with a large harbor and lighthouse; located in Johto
19.name: Olivine City

20.content: Cianwood City — Gym leader is Chuck; gym badge is Storm Badge; small city on an island south of Olivine City; located in Johto
20.name: Cianwood City

21.content: Mahogany Town — Gym leader is Pryce; gym badge is Glacier Badge; located in Johto; the Lake of Rage is a short walk north of Mahogany Town
21.name: Mahogany Town

22.content: Blackthorn City — Gym leader is Clair; gym badge is Rising Badge; old city with cobblestone roads and dragon decor throughout; Lance and Clair's hometown; located in Johto; city is named after the Blackthorn Family who founded it centuries ago
22.name: Blackthorn City

23.content: Indigo Plateau — the final destination for all Moemon trainers that want to challenge the Moemon league, they will have to defeat the Elite Four and the Champion in order to receive the rank of Moemon Master
23.name: Indigo Plateau

24.content: Viridian Forest — A large forest bordering Viridian City in Kanto; home to many Moemon
24.name: Viridian Forest

25.content: Whirl Islands — mysterious islands in southwestern Johto that are so dangerous that only the most experienced Moemon trainers dare venture there; legend has it that the legendary Moemon Lugia is connected to these islands
25.name: Whirl Islands

26.content: Ice Path — an enormous frozen cavern that can be found on the road between Blackthorn City and Mahogany Town in Johto; houses many rare ice-type Moemon; rumored to be the home of Articuno
26.name: Ice Path

27.content: Mount Silver — one of the most dangerous regions in both Kanto and Johto, this mountain range is on the border connecting the two regions and is known to have some of the strongest wild Moemon around
27.name: Mount Silver

28.content: Lake of Rage — a lake located north of Mahogany Town in Johto that is known for having many Magikarp and Gyarados
28.name: Lake of Rage

29.content: Flint Harrison — male; human; Gym Leader of Pewter City Gym; uses rock-type Moemon; gives Boulder Badge to any Moemon trainers who defeat him in a Moemon battle; wife is Lola; has 12 kids including Brock
29.name: Flint

30.content: Daisy — female; human; Gym Leader of Cerulean City Gym; uses water-type Moemon; is Misty's older sister; gives Cascade Badge to any Moemon trainers who defeat her in a Moemon battle
30.name: Daisy

61.name: Eusine

62.content: The Burned Tower — a ruin in Ecruteak City that was once a pagoda tower; stands beside the Bell Tower; used to be called the Brass Tower before it burned down during a thunderstorm; three legendary Moemon named Entei, Suicune, and Raikou perished in the fire but were resurrected by Ho-Oh
62.name: Burned Tower

63.content: The Bell Tower — A pagoda tower in Ecruteak City that is sometimes called the Tin Tower; the legendary Moemon called Ho-Oh can be summoned to the top of the tower with a rare item called 'Rainbow Wing'
63.name: Bell Tower

64.content: Blackthorn Family — a prestigious family of dragon Moemon trainers; they founded Blackthorn City in northeast Johto; Lance is the family heir; current head of the family is Aldric
64.name: Blackthorn Clan

65.content: National Park — a large park north of Goldenrod City in Johto that hosts a popular Bug Moemon Catching Contest on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays.
65.name: National Park

66.content: Ruins of Alph — a mysterious ruin south of Violet City in Johto that is filled with various Moemon known as Unown; contains puzzles to solve in each room
66.name: Ruins of Alph

67.content: Ilex Forest — A forest in Johto that lies west of Azalea Town and south of Goldenrod City; contains a shrine associated with the legendary Moemon Celebi; this forest is very dense and very dark but is not very dangerous
67.name: Ilex Forest

68.content: Union Cave — A medium-sized cave that lies south of Violet City and north of Azalea Town in Johto; a popular training location for young Moemon trainers because it is not overly dangerous
68.name: Union Cave

69.content: Dark Cave — an extremely vast cavern located in Johto; it connects to Route 45 to Blackthorn City, Route 46 to New Bark Town, and Route 31 to Violet City; the upper levels have mostly weak Moemon but the deeper into the cavern you go, the more dangerous it gets
69.name: Dark Cave

70.content: Tohjo Falls — An enormous waterfall located on the border between Kanto and Johto, south of Mount Silver; a cave behind the waterfall is the secret lair of Giovanni of Team Rocket
70.name: Tohjo Falls

71.content: Victory Road — a maze of caves that must be traversed by all Moemon trainers who have 8 or more Gym Badges and wish to challenge the Elite Four at Indigo Plateau; these caves are full of high level Moemon; there is a secret underground magma chamber that houses the legendary bird Moemon, Moltres.
71.name: Victory Road

72.content: Seafoam Islands — a pair of islands in Kanto located east of Cinnabar Island; was once the home of the legendary Moemon called Articuno until the volcano on Cinnabar Island erupted and forced Articuno to move to the Ice Path
72.name: Seafoam Islands

73.content: Mt. Moon — a mountain in northern Kanto; located east of Pewter City and west of Cerulean City; features a complex cave system with mid-level Moemon
73.name: Mt. Moon

74.content: The Power Plant — an enormous facility that provides power to most of Kanto; located on Route 10 just north of Lavender Town; most people don't realize that the legendary Moemon Zapdos resides at the top of the tower
74.name: Power Plant

75.content: Sevii Islands — a cluster of nine islands, each one named for a number; Four Island is the home of Lorelei; islands are located in Kanto to the south; can be accessed by the ship 'Seagallop'
75.name: Sevii Islands

76.content: The Seagallop — a ferry that can bring people from the Kanto mainland to any one of the nine Sevii Islands
76.name: Seagallop

77.content: Safari Zone — a large expanse of land located north of Cianwood City in Johto; owner is a man named Baoba; features a Moemon catching contest where trainers use Safari Balls to capture only one Moemon, which are then scored by the Moemon's strength and rarity, and a prize is given to the winner
77.name: Safari Zone

78.content: Mt. Mortar — a tall mountain in the Johto region with a complex cave system; located on Route 42 between Mahogany Town and Ecruteak City; contains mid-level Moemon
78.name: Mt. Mortar

79.content: Sprout Tower — a pagoda tower in the Johto region's Violet City where a group of monks offer battles to inexperienced Moemon trainers to patiently guide them and help them grow into more capable trainers with sound advice; a common stop on the beginning of a Moemon trainer's journey.
79.name: Sprout Tower

80.content: The Dragon's Den — a cave in Blackthorn City that has a shrine to dragon-type Moemon; only Moemon trainers with permission from the Blackthorn Clan can train here; home to many dragon-type Moemon
80.name: Dragon's Den

81.content: Pokégear — the equivalent of a smartphone in the world of Moemon; has apps for making calls, sending text messages, taking pictures, listening to the radio, and a map.
81.name: Pokégear

82.content: Agatha — female; human; former member of the Kanto Elite Four; uses ghost-type Moemon; known for her long-standing rivalry with Professor Oak
82.name: Agatha

83.content: Bulbasaur — the Seed Moemon; a Grass/Poison-type girl. The seed on her back grows larger as she soaks up sunlight. She keeps her hair in short twin buds and favors overalls stitched with vine patterns. Calm and nurturing by nature, she has a habit of humming to the plants she passes and refuses to walk by a wilting flower without watering it. She evolves into Ivysaur starting around level 16.
83.name: Bulbasaur

84.content: Ivysaur — the Seed Moemon; a Grass/Poison-type girl. Exposure to sunlight makes the bud on her back swell and grow. Her braided hair has grown heavier along with her bud, and she's taken to soft earth-toned dresses that hide the extra weight on her back. Sweet-tempered and a little sleepy, she naps constantly and insists it's essential to her growth. She's the evolved form of Bulbasaur, reached starting around level 16. She evolves into Venusaur starting around level 32.
84.name: Ivysaur

85.content: Venusaur — the Seed Moemon; a Grass/Poison-type girl. She draws energy from the flower on her back, turning sunlight into power. A wide flower blooms like a sun hat over her shoulders, framing an unusually serene, motherly face for someone her age. She rarely raises her voice, preferring to settle disputes among younger Moemon with a look and a patient word. She's the evolved form of Ivysaur, reached starting around level 32.
85.name: Venusaur

86.content: Charmander — the Lizard Moemon; a Fire-type girl. The flame on her tail tip reflects her health and mood. Spiky orange-red hair frames a face that's always mid-grin, mischief clearly brewing. She loves showing off tricks with her tail-flame to impress new friends, though she gets embarrassed when it fizzles at the wrong moment. She evolves into Charmeleon starting around level 16.
86.name: Charmander

87.content: Charmeleon — the Flame Moemon; a Fire-type girl. She swings her tail to raise heat and scorch her surroundings. Wilder-haired and sharper-eyed than her earlier self, with scorch marks on her sleeves from her own temper. She's competitive to a fault, quick to challenge anyone who so much as glances at her the wrong way. She's the evolved form of Charmander, reached starting around level 16. She evolves into Charizard starting around level 36.
87.name: Charmeleon

88.content: Charizard — the Flame Moemon; a Fire/Flying-type girl. She breathes fire hot enough to melt boulders and soars through the skies. Fire-orange hair streams behind translucent, wing-like fins as she soars. She has a soft spot for smaller Moemon despite her swagger, and secretly practices her most dramatic poses in private before showing them off in public. She's the evolved form of Charmeleon, reached starting around level 36.
88.name: Charizard

89.content: Squirtle — the Tiny Turtle Moemon; a Water-type girl. She hides in her shell and sprays water when she feels threatened. Blue-haired and perpetually grinning, with a round shell-backpack scuffed from constant use. She collects smooth stones from every body of water she visits and keeps them rattling around inside her shell like trophies. She evolves into Wartortle starting around level 16.
89.name: Squirtle

90.content: Wartortle — the Turtle Moemon; a Water-type girl. Her fluffy tail is said to be a symbol of longevity. Fluffy fur-like tufts frame her shell now, said to bring luck to whoever spots her. Old-fashioned in her manners, she insists on formal greetings and disapproves — gently — of trainers who rush through their training. She's the evolved form of Squirtle, reached starting around level 16. She evolves into Blastoise starting around level 36.
90.name: Wartortle

91.content: Blastoise — the Shellfish Moemon; a Water-type girl. She fires high-pressure jets of water from the cannons on her shell. Broad-shouldered with twin water-cannon gauntlets she keeps polished to a shine. Stoic in battle but surprisingly soft-spoken otherwise, she has a quiet fondness for rainy days and the sound water makes against her shell. She's the evolved form of Wartortle, reached starting around level 36.
91.name: Blastoise

92.content: Caterpie — the Worm Moemon; a Bug-type girl. Her huge appetite lets her grow and shed her skin quickly. Green-and-yellow striped, cheeks perpetually stuffed with whatever leaf she found last. She keeps a running mental list of the tastiest plants on every route she's traveled, and isn't shy about backtracking for a good one. She evolves into Metapod starting around level 7.
92.name: Caterpie

93.content: Metapod — the Cocoon Moemon; a Bug-type girl. She hardens her shell to shield her soft body while she prepares to evolve. Bundled in a hard shell-cloak, barely visible except for two watchful eyes. She hums a soft, steady tune to herself the whole time she's cocooned, as if counting down the days until she can move again. She's the evolved form of Caterpie, reached starting around level 7. She evolves into Butterfree starting around level 10.
93.name: Metapod

94.content: Butterfree — the Butterfly Moemon; a Bug/Flying-type girl. Her wings are coated in water-repellent, toxic scales. Powder-dusted wings unfold like a ballgown behind her. Graceful in flight but clumsy on the ground, she's constantly bumping into furniture and laughing it off with a shrug and a dusting of shimmering scale-powder. She's the evolved form of Metapod, reached starting around level 10.
94.name: Butterfree

95.content: Weedle — the Hairy Bug Moemon; a Bug/Poison-type girl. The stinger on her head is sharp and poisonous. A sharp horn-like hairpin sits above bright, easily-startled eyes. She flinches at loud noises but has a stubborn streak underneath — corner her and she'll stand her ground with her stinger raised, shaking the whole time. She evolves into Kakuna starting around level 7.
95.name: Weedle

96.content: Kakuna — the Cocoon Moemon; a Bug/Poison-type girl. She stays nearly still, but can still jab with her poison stinger if disturbed. Wrapped tight in a hard cocoon-shell, only her face free to move. She counts silently to pass the time, and has been known to lose track entirely and just doze off mid-count. She's the evolved form of Weedle, reached starting around level 7. She evolves into Beedrill starting around level 10.
96.name: Kakuna

97.content: Beedrill — the Poison Bee Moemon; a Bug/Poison-type girl. She fiercely defends her hive using three venomous stingers. Armored in twin venom-tipped gauntlets, with a third stinger worn like a tiara over neatly braided hair. Fiercely loyal to her hive-sisters, she keeps a running tally of anyone who's ever threatened them — and never forgets a face. She's the evolved form of Kakuna, reached starting around level 10.
97.name: Beedrill

98.content: Pidgey — the Tiny Bird Moemon; a Normal/Flying-type girl. Docile and common, but she fights back fiercely when provoked. Brown-and-cream feathers frame a face that's always scanning for the nearest exit. Easily startled but weirdly stubborn once cornered, she has a habit of puffing herself up to look bigger than she is. She evolves into Pidgeotto starting around level 18.
98.name: Pidgey

99.content: Pidgeotto — the Bird Moemon; a Normal/Flying-type girl. She claims a wide territory and defends her relentlessly. Crested and sharp-eyed, patrolling her claimed territory with visible pride. She's picked up a habit of scolding smaller Moemon who wander too close, though she softens the moment they look genuinely lost. She's the evolved form of Pidgey, reached starting around level 18. She evolves into Pidgeot starting around level 36.
99.name: Pidgeotto

100.content: Pidgeot — the Bird Moemon; a Normal/Flying-type girl. She flies at superb speeds, powered by well-developed chest muscles. A long crest of feathers streams behind her in flight, catching the wind like a banner. She's competitive about speed above all else, and has been known to challenge total strangers to impromptu races. She's the evolved form of Pidgeotto, reached starting around level 36.
100.name: Pidgeot

101.content: Rattata — the Mouse Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Extremely adaptable, she can be found living almost anywhere. Choppy purple-brown hair and a satchel of scavenged odds and ends. She trades favors like currency, always seeming to know someone who owes her something, and can find a shortcut through nearly any town. She evolves into Raticate starting around level 20.
101.name: Rattata

102.content: Raticate — the Mouse Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her teeth never stop growing, so she gnaws on hard objects to file them down. Buck-toothed, forever gnawing something to keep her teeth in check. Surprisingly protective of smaller Moemon, she's the first to bare those same teeth at anyone who bullies them. She's the evolved form of Rattata, reached starting around level 20.
102.name: Raticate

103.content: Spearow — the Tiny Bird Moemon; a Normal/Flying-type girl. She cries loudly to alert her flock and lashes out at intruders. Wild reddish hair and a voice built for shouting warnings. She's picked up the habit of narrating danger out loud even when there isn't any, much to the exasperation of everyone traveling with her. She evolves into Fearow starting around level 20.
103.name: Spearow

104.content: Fearow — the Beak Moemon; a Normal/Flying-type girl. Her sturdy wings let her fly all day without tiring. Long-limbed with a sharp beak-like piercing at her nose. She measures distance in flight-hours rather than miles, and takes quiet pride in never once asking for a rest stop. She's the evolved form of Spearow, reached starting around level 20.
104.name: Fearow

105.content: Ekans — the Snake Moemon; a Poison-type girl. She coils up to strike, hunting mostly at night. Purple scale-patterned leggings and a habit of coiling up in warm, dark corners. Quiet by day, she comes alive after sunset, and has a fondness for warm stones she likes to curl around before hunting. She evolves into Arbok starting around level 22.
105.name: Ekans

106.content: Arbok — the Cobra Moemon; a Poison-type girl. The pattern on her hood frightens foes before she strikes. A hood-like collar patterned to look like a second, glaring face. She loves a dramatic entrance, timing her strikes for maximum shock value, and practices her most intimidating pose in still water when no one's watching. She's the evolved form of Ekans, reached starting around level 22.
106.name: Arbok

107.content: Pikachu — the Mouse Moemon; an Electric-type girl. She stores electricity in her cheeks and occasionally lets her out by accident. Round red cheek-pouches spark faintly even at rest. She has a habit of humming little electric jingles under her breath, and gets embarrassed — sparking harder — whenever someone points it out. She's the evolved form of Pichu, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough. She evolves into Raichu when exposed to a Thunder Stone.
107.name: Pikachu

108.content: Raichu — the Mouse Moemon; an Electric-type girl. The electricity she stores can reach high voltages that shock even her if she's not careful. Longer-eared and constantly crackling with static in her hair. She's more careful with her power than she used to be, having learned the hard way, though she still can't resist showing off for an audience she trusts. She's the evolved form of Pikachu, reached when exposed to a Thunder Stone.
108.name: Raichu

109.content: Sandshrew — the Mouse Moemon; a Ground-type girl. Burrows deep underground to avoid water; her body is covered in dry, protective hide. Sandy-tan and soft-spoken, most at ease half-buried out of sight. She has a habit of falling asleep mid-conversation if the ground beneath her is warm enough, and denies it every time. She evolves into Sandslash starting around level 22.
109.name: Sandshrew

110.content: Sandslash — the Mouse Moemon; a Ground-type girl. Curls into a spiky ball to protect herself and rolls at enemies to attack. Spiky and armored, with claw-like nails she keeps meticulously filed. Prickly with strangers but fiercely loyal once she warms up, she has a soft spot for anyone patient enough to earn her trust. She's the evolved form of Sandshrew, reached starting around level 22.
110.name: Sandslash

111.content: Nidoran♀ — the Poison Pin Moemon; a Poison-type girl. Small and docile, but her poison barbs make her a surprisingly dangerous opponent. Small and pink-eared, little poison-barb hairpins glinting when she moves. Sweet until provoked, she has a habit of humming to herself while gathering herbs, most of which turn out to be mildly toxic. She evolves into Nidorina starting around level 16.
111.name: Nidoran♀

112.content: Nidorina — the Poison Pin Moemon; a Poison-type girl. Cares for her young by chewing food and softening her before feeding them. Rounder-faced and endlessly fussing over younger Moemon like a doting big sister. She keeps a mental roster of everyone in her care and worries when even one goes quiet for too long. She's the evolved form of Nidoran♀, reached starting around level 16. She evolves into Nidoqueen when exposed to a Moon Stone.
112.name: Nidorina

113.content: Nidoqueen — the Drill Moemon; a Poison/Ground-type girl. Her armored hide barely feels attacks; she defends her young from any threat. Regal and armored, carrying herself like visiting royalty even in the middle of a fight. She has little patience for nonsense, but softens instantly the moment a young Moemon needs comforting. She's the evolved form of Nidorina, reached when exposed to a Moon Stone.
113.name: Nidoqueen

114.content: Nidoran♂ — the Poison Pin Moemon; a Poison-type girl. Flaps her large ears to listen for approaching danger, her horns full of venom. Horned and alert, ears swiveling toward every distant sound. She startles easily but recovers fast, snapping straight into a fighting stance with barely a beat of hesitation. She evolves into Nidorino starting around level 16.
114.name: Nidoran♂

115.content: Nidorino — the Poison Pin Moemon; a Poison-type girl. Easily angered; she charges with her horn when she senses any threat. Hot-headed, horn lowered at the first sign of a threat. She's impulsive to a fault, charging first and asking questions later — usually while still mid-charge. She's the evolved form of Nidoran♂, reached starting around level 16. She evolves into Nidoking when exposed to a Moon Stone.
115.name: Nidorino

116.content: Nidoking — the Drill Moemon; a Poison/Ground-type girl. Her thick tail can topple a tower in one swing; her hide is tough as armor. Towering and powerfully built, her thick tail used as much for balance as for battle. Commanding in presence, she's surprisingly gentle in private, especially toward anyone smaller who looks lost. She's the evolved form of Nidorino, reached when exposed to a Moon Stone.
116.name: Nidoking

117.content: Clefairy — the Fairy Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Very rare and shy; she comes out to dance under the light of the full moon. Soft pink and cream, most herself under moonlight. Bashful around strangers, she keeps a small collection of pretty stones she's found while dancing, treasuring each one like a secret. She's the evolved form of Cleffa, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough. She evolves into Clefable when exposed to a Moon Stone.
117.name: Clefairy

118.content: Clefable — the Fairy Moemon; a Normal-type girl. A cautious fairy Moemon that rarely shows herself to humans. Graceful and reclusive, rarely seen outside quiet moonlit clearings. She prefers a small circle of trusted company, and has a quiet habit of leaving little gifts for anyone who's shown her kindness. She's the evolved form of Clefairy, reached when exposed to a Moon Stone.
118.name: Clefable

119.content: Vulpix — the Fox Moemon; a Fire-type girl. At birth she has one tail, which splits into several as she grows; each tail holds a flame. Fluffy-eared with a single flame-tipped tail, warm to the touch even in winter. Playful and affectionate, she loves curling up near a fire and has a habit of falling asleep the moment she gets comfortable. She evolves into Ninetales when exposed to a Fire Stone.
119.name: Vulpix

120.content: Ninetales — the Fox Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Said to live for a thousand years; her nine tails hold mystical power. Nine flowing tails trail behind an ageless, knowing gaze. Composed and a little mysterious, she rarely explains herself, preferring riddles and long silences to straightforward answers. She's the evolved form of Vulpix, reached when exposed to a Fire Stone.
120.name: Ninetales

121.content: Jigglypuff — the Balloon Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her soothing song can lull anyone to sleep; she puffs up when angry. Round-cheeked and pink, with a singing voice she's proud of. Sweet and a little naive, she carries a small microphone-shaped charm everywhere and performs for anyone who'll sit still long enough to listen. She's the evolved form of Igglybuff, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough. She evolves into Wigglytuff when exposed to a Moon Stone.
121.name: Jigglypuff

122.content: Wigglytuff — the Balloon Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her soft, flexible fur is prized; she inflates drastically when provoked. Soft, fluffy, and wide-eyed. Bubbly and affectionate, she has a habit of hugging first and asking permission after, and takes any hint of rejection surprisingly hard. She's the evolved form of Jigglypuff, reached when exposed to a Moon Stone.
122.name: Wigglytuff

123.content: Zubat — the Bat Moemon; a Poison/Flying-type girl. She navigates dark caves with ultrasonic waves; she has no eyes. Pale and eyeless, navigating entirely by sound. Skittish around bright light, she's remarkably graceful in the dark, and has learned to recognize her closest friends by footstep alone. She evolves into Golbat starting around level 22.
123.name: Zubat

124.content: Golbat — the Bat Moemon; a Poison/Flying-type girl. Drinks the blood of her prey and only stops when she can barely fly. Sharp-fanged with an unsettling grin, most active after dark. She's constantly hungry and a little embarrassed about it, sneaking snacks between meals and denying it with her mouth still full. She's the evolved form of Zubat, reached starting around level 22. She evolves into Crobat once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
124.name: Golbat

125.content: Oddish — the Weed Moemon; a Grass/Poison-type girl. Buries herself in the ground during the day and walks around at night, sowing seeds. Leafy-haired and nocturnal, humming softly while she tends gardens no one asked her to tend. Quiet and dreamy, she has an uncanny knack for knowing exactly which plants need water before anyone else notices. She evolves into Gloom starting around level 21.
125.name: Oddish

126.content: Gloom — the Weed Moemon; a Grass/Poison-type girl. She drips sweet nectar from her mouth; the stench she emits can knock people out. Drowsy-eyed with sweet nectar always dripping from her lips. Kind-hearted and a little oblivious, she offers her nectar to anyone who looks tired, unaware it usually just puts them straight to sleep. She's the evolved form of Oddish, reached starting around level 21. Depending on how she's raised, she can evolve into Vileplume (when exposed to a Leaf Stone) or Bellossom (when exposed to a Sun Stone).
126.name: Gloom

127.content: Vileplume — the Flower Moemon; a Grass/Poison-type girl. Her giant petals release clouds of toxic pollen that can paralyze. Crowned with an enormous, trailing flower she's visibly proud of. Vain in a theatrical way, she loves compliments about her petals and sulks — dramatically — if no one offers any. She's the evolved form of Gloom, reached when exposed to a Leaf Stone.
127.name: Vileplume

128.content: Paras — the Mushroom Moemon; a Bug/Grass-type girl. The mushrooms on her back are parasites that leech nutrients while she burrows. Quiet, with strange mushroom growths clinging to her shoulders. Distracted and dreamy, she's prone to trailing off mid-sentence, as if listening to something only she can hear. She evolves into Parasect starting around level 24.
128.name: Paras

129.content: Parasect — the Mushroom Moemon; a Bug/Grass-type girl. The mushroom on her back has taken over her host, controlling her actions. Blank-eyed and unnervingly calm, moving with flat, mechanical stillness. She rarely initiates conversation anymore, though those who knew her before say flickers of her old self still surface now and then. She's the evolved form of Paras, reached starting around level 24.
129.name: Parasect

130.content: Venonat — the Insect Moemon; a Bug/Poison-type girl. Her large eyes are like radar; she hunts small bugs at night. Wide-eyed behind oversized goggle-like lenses. Curious and a little jumpy, she keeps a private collection of pressed bugs and insists, unconvincingly, that they're all just resting. She evolves into Venomoth starting around level 31.
130.name: Venonat

131.content: Venomoth — the Poison Moth Moemon; a Bug/Poison-type girl. Her fluttering wings scatter toxic scales that can be deadly. Moth-winged, trailing shimmering dust when she flies. Dreamy and drawn to bright lights, she's singed her own wings more than once chasing a particularly pretty lantern. She's the evolved form of Venonat, reached starting around level 31.
131.name: Venomoth

132.content: Diglett — the Mole Moemon; a Ground-type girl. Lives underground and eats plant roots; farmers consider her a pest. Only ever seen from the shoulders up, deadpan even mid-conversation. Shy and reclusive, she keeps meticulous mental maps of every tunnel she's ever dug and refuses to explain how she remembers them all. She evolves into Dugtrio starting around level 26.
132.name: Diglett

133.content: Dugtrio — the Mole Moemon; a Ground-type girl. A trio of Diglett sharing one body; she digs immense tunnels at speed. Hair styled in three tight braids, moving with eerie three-way synchrony. Businesslike and efficient, she finishes sentences faster than expected — sometimes literally in three overlapping voices at once. She's the evolved form of Diglett, reached starting around level 26.
133.name: Dugtrio

134.content: Meowth — the Scratch Cat Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Adores shiny coins; she prowls at night collecting anything that glitters. Sleek and cat-eared, obsessively polishing a gold coin charm. Sly and a little greedy, she keeps a running mental ledger of who owes her a favor, and always, always collects. She evolves into Persian starting around level 28.
134.name: Meowth

135.content: Persian — the Classy Cat Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Elegant and proud; her fine-tuned muscles let her move silently. Immaculately groomed, moving without a sound. Aloof and a touch vain, she judges other Moemon primarily by how well-kept their fur is, and rarely bothers hiding it. She's the evolved form of Meowth, reached starting around level 28.
135.name: Persian

136.content: Psyduck — the Duck Moemon; a Water-type girl. Her mysterious headache seems to spark odd psychic powers when she worsens. Perpetually clutching her head with a pained expression. Airheaded and clumsy day to day, though her rare moments of clarity are sharp enough to startle everyone around her, herself included. She evolves into Golduck starting around level 33.
136.name: Psyduck

137.content: Golduck — the Duck Moemon; a Water-type girl. A superb swimmer; the gem on her forehead lets her channel psychic power. Composed, with a smooth blue gem set at her brow. Calm and focused, she meditates daily to keep her powers steady, though she'll admit — quietly — that she still gets headaches sometimes too. She's the evolved form of Psyduck, reached starting around level 33.
137.name: Golduck

138.content: Mankey — the Pig Monkey Moemon; a Fighting-type girl. Flies into a rage over the smallest things; her tree-dwelling troop is always noisy. Short-tempered and scrappy, baring her teeth over the smallest slight. Loud and excitable, she's rarely without her rowdy troop nearby, and gets oddly quiet and sulky whenever she's left alone. She evolves into Primeape starting around level 28.
138.name: Mankey

139.content: Primeape — the Pig Monkey Moemon; a Fighting-type girl. Once she starts raging she won't stop until the target is gone; she's always fierce. Once her temper flares, she's nearly impossible to stop. Between outbursts she's surprisingly calm and even a little sheepish, apologizing afterward for messes she barely remembers making. She's the evolved form of Mankey, reached starting around level 28.
139.name: Primeape

140.content: Growlithe — the Puppy Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Loyal and brave; she fiercely protects the territory and people she trusts. Floppy-eared with an eager, devoted expression that rarely fades. She greets every reunion — even after just an hour apart — like it's the best thing that's happened all day, and means it every time. She evolves into Arcanine when exposed to a Fire Stone.
140.name: Growlithe

141.content: Arcanine — the Legendary Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Legendary in some regions; she runs with speed and grace like the wind. Tall and maned like a lion, carrying herself with quiet nobility. She rarely brags about her legendary status, preferring to let her speed and steady presence speak for themselves. She's the evolved form of Growlithe, reached when exposed to a Fire Stone.
141.name: Arcanine

142.content: Poliwag — the Tadpole Moemon; a Water-type girl. The swirl on her belly shows through her skin; newly hatched she can barely swim. Round-bellied and perpetually damp, blinking with a slightly bewildered expression. Clumsy on land, she's oddly proud of how far she's come since hatching, however wobbly her first steps still are. She evolves into Poliwhirl starting around level 25.
142.name: Poliwag

143.content: Poliwhirl — the Tadpole Moemon; a Water-type girl. Her skin is always slick; she can walk on land and swim in water. Slick-skinned and amphibious, equally comfortable on a riverbank or fully submerged. Easygoing to a fault, she has a habit of wandering off mid-conversation toward the nearest puddle. She's the evolved form of Poliwag, reached starting around level 25. Depending on how she's raised, she can evolve into Poliwrath (when exposed to a Water Stone) or Politoed (through trade while holding a King's Rock).
143.name: Poliwhirl

144.content: Poliwrath — the Tadpole Moemon; a Water/Fighting-type girl. A master swimmer and fighter; she can punch fast enough to break rocks. Athletic and toned, with a fighter's stance she holds even at rest. Disciplined in training, she keeps a strict daily regimen and looks faintly disappointed in anyone who skips a workout. She's the evolved form of Poliwhirl, reached when exposed to a Water Stone.
144.name: Poliwrath

145.content: Abra — the Psi Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. She sleeps 18 hours a day and teleports away at the first sign of danger. Perpetually drowsy, dozing upright with one eye cracked open. Skittish under the sleepiness, she keeps an escape route mapped out even mid-nap, muscle memory taking over before she's fully awake. She evolves into Kadabra starting around level 16.
145.name: Abra

146.content: Kadabra — the Psi Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. She emits alpha waves strong enough to cause headaches in those nearby. Sharper-featured, a faint psychic shimmer trailing her like static. Intense and inward-focused, she mutters half-finished calculations under her breath and rarely notices she's doing it. She's the evolved form of Abra, reached starting around level 16. She evolves into Alakazam through trade.
146.name: Kadabra

147.content: Alakazam — the Psi Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. Her IQ is said to be 5,000; she remembers everything she has ever experienced. Composed and sharp-eyed, carrying herself like she already knows how the conversation ends. Calm and calculating, she has a habit of finishing other people's sentences — correctly, which somehow makes it worse. She's the evolved form of Kadabra, reached through trade.
147.name: Alakazam

148.content: Machop — the Superpower Moemon; a Fighting-type girl. Her body is pure muscle; small but strong enough to throw a hundred adults. Small but visibly muscular under a simple tracksuit. Cheerful and hardworking, she trains before sunrise out of sheer enthusiasm and greets every new day like a fresh chance to get stronger. She evolves into Machoke starting around level 28.
148.name: Machop

149.content: Machoke — the Superpower Moemon; a Fighting-type girl. Her muscles are as hard as steel; she lifts tremendous weights with ease. Broader and steel-hard with effort, veins standing out along corded arms. Stoic and diligent, she rarely complains about the workload, quietly taking on more than her share without being asked. She's the evolved form of Machop, reached starting around level 28. She evolves into Machamp through trade.
149.name: Machoke

150.content: Machamp — the Superpower Moemon; a Fighting-type girl. With four arms she throws countless punches in a single second. Four muscular arms moving with practiced coordination. Confident and competitive, she keeps informal count of every sparring match she's ever won and brings it up more than her opponents would like. She's the evolved form of Machoke, reached through trade.
150.name: Machamp

151.content: Bellsprout — the Flower Moemon; a Grass/Poison-type girl. Lures prey with her vine and swallows her whole once caught. Sweet-faced with a quick, vine-like reach. Charming on the surface, she's learned to soften her hungrier instincts around friends, though newcomers still get an unsettling once-over. She evolves into Weepinbell starting around level 21.
151.name: Bellsprout

152.content: Weepinbell — the Flycatcher Moemon; a Grass/Poison-type girl. She spits acid to dissolve prey, which she then consumes. Sharper and more predatory, moving with unhurried precision. Patient when hunting, she's oddly relaxed the rest of the time, content to sun herself for hours between meals. She's the evolved form of Bellsprout, reached starting around level 21. She evolves into Victreebel when exposed to a Leaf Stone.
152.name: Weepinbell

153.content: Victreebel — the Flycatcher Moemon; a Grass/Poison-type girl. Said to live in large groups deep in the jungle where no one can find them. Reclusive, most at home deep in dense jungle cover. Wary of outsiders at first, she's fiercely social once she trusts someone, sharing food and territory without hesitation. She's the evolved form of Weepinbell, reached when exposed to a Leaf Stone.
153.name: Victreebel

154.content: Tentacool — the Jellyfish Moemon; a Water/Poison-type girl. Her body is mostly water; she drifts in the sea stinging anything that touches her. Translucent, trailing long stinging tendrils like ribbons. Drifty and aloof, she rarely initiates contact, preferring to let curious strangers approach her first — usually to their regret. She evolves into Tentacruel starting around level 30.
154.name: Tentacool

155.content: Tentacruel — the Jellyfish Moemon; a Water/Poison-type girl. The 80 tentacles on her body sting and drain prey's fluids. Covered in dozens of trailing tendrils, more imposing than her earlier form. Businesslike when hunting, she's calmer than her reputation suggests, and keeps mostly to herself between meals. She's the evolved form of Tentacool, reached starting around level 30.
155.name: Tentacruel

156.content: Geodude — the Rock Moemon; a Rock/Ground-type girl. Often mistaken for a rock; she rolls downhill and crashes into things. Compact and rock-solid, easy to mistake for scenery when still. Blunt and stubborn, she'd rather barrel through an obstacle than think her way around it, dents be damned. She evolves into Graveler starting around level 25.
156.name: Geodude

157.content: Graveler — the Rock Moemon; a Rock/Ground-type girl. Rolls down slopes and eats rocks; she grows by absorbing minerals. Larger and craggier, with a habit of snacking on stray pebbles between meals. Easygoing and steady, she treats mineral-rich terrain like a buffet and complains when the pickings are thin. She's the evolved form of Geodude, reached starting around level 25. She evolves into Golem through trade.
157.name: Graveler

158.content: Golem — the Megaton Moemon; a Rock/Ground-type girl. Once a year she sheds her rocky shell and grows; she detonates when angered. Massive and armored, shedding her rocky shell once a year in a private ritual few get to witness. Usually calm, she has a hair-trigger temper when provoked and very little warning before it goes off. She's the evolved form of Graveler, reached through trade.
158.name: Golem

159.content: Ponyta — the Fire Horse Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Her legs grow strong from running soon after birth; her fiery mane lights the way. Slender and long-legged, mane flickering faintly even at rest. Energetic since birth, she runs laps just for the joy of it and gets restless if kept still too long. She evolves into Rapidash starting around level 40.
159.name: Ponyta

160.content: Rapidash — the Fire Horse Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Races at speeds up to 150 mph; her blazing mane burns fiercely. Sleek and built for speed, mane streaming at a full gallop. Competitive and a little reckless, she times herself against no one but her own best record — and takes it personally when she loses to it. She's the evolved form of Ponyta, reached starting around level 40.
160.name: Rapidash

161.content: Slowpoke — the Dopey Moemon; a Water/Psychic-type girl. Slow in both body and mind; she spends the day lazing near the water. Perpetually half-asleep, a vacant, dreamy look permanently on her face. Slow-witted but sweet, she's been known to wander into rivers mid-thought and stand there for hours, unbothered. Depending on how she's raised, she can evolve into Slowbro (starting around level 37, or the moment a Shellder clamps onto her tail) or Slowking (through trade while holding a King's Rock).
161.name: Slowpoke

162.content: Slowbro — the Hermit Crab Moemon; a Water/Psychic-type girl. She lost her urgency when a Shellder clamped onto her tail and made her calm. Round-faced and placid, moving at an unhurried, almost floating pace. Whatever urgency she used to have seems to have drained away entirely, and she's not the least bit interested in getting it back. Serene to a fault, she's forgotten what she was worried about in the first place — and doesn't miss it. She's the evolved form of Slowpoke, reached starting around level 37, or the moment a Shellder clamps onto her tail.
162.name: Slowbro

163.content: Magnemite — the Magnet Moemon; an Electric/Steel-type girl. Floats using electromagnetic waves; she gathers near power lines. Small and metallic, hovering with a faint electromagnetic hum. Quiet and a little robotic in her mannerisms, she's inexplicably drawn to anything with a working battery. She evolves into Magneton starting around level 30.
163.name: Magnemite

164.content: Magneton — the Magnet Moemon; an Electric/Steel-type girl. Three Magnemite linked by magnetism; she appears during sunspot activity. Geometric and metallic, orbiting close together as if magnetically tethered. Her three voices overlap when she speaks, finishing each other's sentences in a way that still unsettles strangers. Detached and mechanical, she communicates best through short, synchronized bursts rather than full conversation. She's the evolved form of Magnemite, reached starting around level 30. She evolves into Magnezone when leveling up in a place charged with strong magnetic energy.
164.name: Magneton

165.content: Farfetch'd — the Wild Duck Moemon; a Normal/Flying-type girl. Always carries a leek stalk; in the past she was hunted to near extinction. Old-fashioned and wistful, leek stalk tucked permanently under one arm. Proud and traditional, she corrects anyone who calls it a weapon — it's a birthright, she insists, not a prop.
165.name: Farfetch'd

166.content: Doduo — the Twin Bird Moemon; a Normal/Flying-type girl. Her two heads sing in turn; she runs at a blinding sprint. Two heads sharing one body, bickering constantly about which way to run. Fast-talking and faster-running, she's rarely stumped for an answer, mostly because she gives two at once. She evolves into Dodrio starting around level 31.
166.name: Doduo

167.content: Dodrio — the Triple Bird Moemon; a Normal/Flying-type girl. Each of her three heads thinks something different; she runs on three legs. Three heads, three wildly different opinions, one exasperated body caught between them. Chaotic and indecisive as a result, though her legs never seem to get the memo and keep sprinting regardless. She's the evolved form of Doduo, reached starting around level 31.
167.name: Dodrio

168.content: Seel — the Sea Lion Moemon; a Water-type girl. Loves cold water; she hunts for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. Sleek and quick, barking cheerfully at anyone who looks even slightly chilly. Adventurous and hardy, she treats frozen seas like a personal playground and pities anyone who prefers warm weather. Adventurous and hardy, she treats frozen seas like a personal playground and pities anyone who prefers warm weather. She evolves into Dewgong starting around level 34.
168.name: Seel

169.content: Dewgong — the Sea Lion Moemon; a Water/Ice-type girl. Her body stores heat in a thick layer of fat; she swims through icy waters with ease. Soft and round, insulated against even the harshest cold. Gentle and easygoing, she hums softly while she swims, the sound carrying strangely far across icy water. She's the evolved form of Seel, reached starting around level 34.
169.name: Dewgong

170.content: Grimer — the Sludge Moemon; a Poison-type girl. Formed from sludge in polluted waters; she leaves toxic trails everywhere. Perpetually damp, leaving faint trails wherever she wanders. Cheerfully unbothered by the mess, she's genuinely surprised whenever someone complains about the smell. She evolves into Muk starting around level 38.
170.name: Grimer

171.content: Muk — the Sludge Moemon; a Poison-type girl. A mass of living filth; she can polish ground down to bedrock just by touching her. A shapeless mass of living sludge, loosely humanoid and constantly shifting shape. Slow-moving and easygoing, she's oddly ticklish for something with no clearly defined skin. She's the evolved form of Grimer, reached starting around level 38.
171.name: Muk

172.content: Shellder — the Bivalve Moemon; a Water-type girl. She clamps on with her shell; she spits sand and water to defend herself. Small and clam-shelled, snapping tight at the first hint of trouble. Cautious at first, she's sharp-tongued and surprisingly funny once she decides you're not a threat. She evolves into Cloyster when exposed to a Water Stone.
172.name: Shellder

173.content: Cloyster — the Bivalve Moemon; a Water/Ice-type girl. Her shell is harder than diamond; she's almost impossible to harm her. Poised and armored, opening her shell only for those she genuinely trusts. Smug about her own durability, she's taken to challenging visitors to try and so much as leave a mark on her — and has yet to lose that bet. She's the evolved form of Shellder, reached when exposed to a Water Stone.
173.name: Cloyster

174.content: Gastly — the Gas Moemon; a Ghost/Poison-type girl. Made of gas; she can sneak through any crack and drain a victim's life force. Barely solid, a drifting wisp of purple gas with glowing eyes. Playful and mischievous, she delights in slipping through cracks to startle people, then dissolving into giggles when they jump. She evolves into Haunter starting around level 25.
174.name: Gastly

175.content: Haunter — the Gas Moemon; a Ghost/Poison-type girl. She lurks in the dark, licking victims to steal their life force and induce shivers. A shadowy, grinning figure lurking at the edges of dark rooms. Impish in her pranks, she keeps a mental scoreboard of every scare she's landed, and sulks when someone doesn't react. She's the evolved form of Gastly, reached starting around level 25. She evolves into Gengar through trade.
175.name: Haunter

176.content: Gengar — the Shadow Moemon; a Ghost/Poison-type girl. She hides in shadows and appears to play tricks; a Gengar's presence chills the air. Cloaked in shifting shadow, grin a little too wide. Sly and theatrical, she treats every prank like a stage performance, complete with a dramatic reveal at the end. She's the evolved form of Haunter, reached through trade.
176.name: Gengar

177.content: Onix — the Rock Snake Moemon; a Rock/Ground-type girl. A giant rock snake that burrows through the ground at high speed. Enormous and serpentine, surprisingly fast for her size. Blunt and unbothered, she's flattened more than a few obstacles without noticing they were even there. She evolves into Steelix through trade while holding a Metal Coat.
177.name: Onix

178.content: Drowzee — the Hypnosis Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. Puts people to sleep and eats their dreams; she prefers the dreams of children. Drowsy-eyed, a swinging pendant always in hand. Gentle but a little unsettling, she keeps a private notebook of the strangest dreams she's sampled, organized by how memorable they were. She evolves into Hypno starting around level 26.
178.name: Drowzee

179.content: Hypno — the Hypnosis Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. Her pendulum swing lulls anyone to sleep; she then feasts on their dreams. Composed and hypnotic, her pendulum swing rarely missing. Calm and patient, she savors her collected dreams slowly, the way some people savor a good meal. She's the evolved form of Drowzee, reached starting around level 26.
179.name: Hypno

180.content: Krabby — the River Crab Moemon; a Water-type girl. Her pincers are powerful weapons; she blows bubbles from her mouth to distract foes. Small and armored, oversized pincer-gauntlets clacking when she's nervous. Feisty and defensive, she blows a stream of bubbles as a warning before ever actually snapping at someone. She evolves into Kingler starting around level 28.
180.name: Krabby

181.content: Kingler — the Pincer Moemon; a Water-type girl. Her giant claw can crush anything; the smaller one is for fine work. One gauntlet built for crushing, the other kept for delicate work. Proud of her strength, she's surprisingly good at fine tasks — sewing, sculpting — that most wouldn't trust her huge claw with. She's the evolved form of Krabby, reached starting around level 28.
181.name: Kingler

182.content: Voltorb — the Ball Moemon; an Electric-type girl. She looks like a Poké Ball; she explodes when touched or shaken. Round and smooth, disguised to look almost exactly like a spare ball. Jumpy and easily startled, she's caused more than a few trainers to reach for the wrong item by mistake. She evolves into Electrode starting around level 30.
182.name: Voltorb

183.content: Electrode — the Ball Moemon; an Electric-type girl. Stores immense electric energy; she detonates at the slightest disturbance. Larger and crackling with barely-contained energy. High-strung and volatile, she counts down under her breath when she feels a build-up coming, though it rarely buys anyone much warning. She's the evolved form of Voltorb, reached starting around level 30.
183.name: Electrode

184.content: Exeggcute — the Egg Moemon; a Grass/Psychic-type girl. Six eggs that communicate telepathically; one cracks and they scatter. Cheerful and giggly, a cluster of six egg-shaped charms murmuring quietly to each other. Playful and scatterbrained, she loses track of which egg said what within minutes. She evolves into Exeggutor when exposed to a Leaf Stone.
184.name: Exeggcute

185.content: Exeggutor — the Coconut Moemon; a Grass/Psychic-type girl. Her three heads think independently; she lives in warm, sunny regions. Three heads with three distinct personalities, sharing one sunny disposition. Warm and easygoing, she debates herself out loud constantly and somehow always reaches agreement. She's the evolved form of Exeggcute, reached when exposed to a Leaf Stone.
185.name: Exeggutor

186.content: Cubone — the Lonely Moemon; a Ground-type girl. She wears the skull of her departed mother and cries at night in memory. Solemn and quiet, a bone-white mask carved in memory of her mother. Grief-touched but resilient, she keeps the mask on during the day and only sets it aside once she's alone. She evolves into Marowak starting around level 28.
186.name: Cubone

187.content: Marowak — the Bone Keeper Moemon; a Ground-type girl. She wields her bone club like a boomerang she has mastered from birth. Fierce and disciplined, her bone club spinning with practiced, dance-like precision. Determined and self-taught, she never lets anyone else correct her form — she earned every motion the hard way. She's the evolved form of Cubone, reached starting around level 28.
187.name: Marowak

188.content: Hitmonlee — the Kicking Moemon; a Fighting-type girl. Her legs stretch freely, letting her kick with devastating force and reach. Long-legged and limber, capable of impossibly high, fast kicks. Focused and competitive, she stretches obsessively before every fight, treating warm-up like half the battle. She's the evolved form of Tyrogue, reached starting around level 20, if her Attack outgrows her Defense.
188.name: Hitmonlee

189.content: Hitmonchan — the Punching Moemon; a Fighting-type girl. Her punches fly faster than the eye can follow; she boxes with lightning speed. Quick-fisted and light on her feet, punches faster than the eye can track. Sharp and precise, she treats every fight like a timed sport and keeps a running tally of her best combos. She's the evolved form of Tyrogue, reached starting around level 20, if her Defense outgrows her Attack.
189.name: Hitmonchan

190.content: Lickitung — the Licking Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her tongue is over six feet long; whatever she licks is coated in her sticky saliva. Easygoing, an absurdly long tongue that rarely stays where it belongs. Friendly to a fault, she's learned to apologize before people even finish flinching. She evolves into Lickilicky by growing strong enough while she's mastered the move Rollout.
190.name: Lickitung

191.content: Koffing — the Poison Gas Moemon; a Poison-type girl. Her body is full of toxic gas that she releases when she's nervous or angry. Perpetually a little bloated-looking, faintly hazy with the gas she carries. Moody and easily set off, she vents in small puffs when stressed and insists it's totally under control. Depending on how she's raised, she can evolve into Weezing (starting around level 35) or Weezing (starting around level 35).
191.name: Koffing

192.content: Weezing — the Poison Gas Moemon; a Poison-type girl. Her twin heads react to poison gas to produce a more potent blend. Two heads that argue constantly, each cooking up a different toxic blend when riled. Volatile and unpredictable, she's most dangerous exactly when the two heads finally agree on something. She's the evolved form of Koffing, reached starting around level 35.
192.name: Weezing

193.content: Rhyhorn — the Spikes Moemon; a Ground/Rock-type girl. Her tiny brain makes her relentlessly single-minded when charging straight ahead. Blunt and headstrong, charging first and thinking never. Simple and direct, she measures problems by how hard she can hit them, and hasn't found many exceptions yet. Depending on how she's raised, she can evolve into Rhydon (starting around level 42) or Rhydon (starting around level 42).
193.name: Rhyhorn

194.content: Rhydon — the Drill Moemon; a Ground/Rock-type girl. Her armor-like hide can withstand even molten lava; her horn drills through rock. Armored and imposing, drill-like horn kept polished and sharp. Tough and resilient, she shrugs off heat that would stop most others cold and considers complaining about it a weakness. She's the evolved form of Rhyhorn, reached starting around level 42. She evolves into Rhyperior through trade while holding a Protector.
194.name: Rhydon

195.content: Chansey — the Egg Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Lays nutritious eggs daily and will share them with injured people and Moemon. Warm and generous, a basket of freshly laid eggs always close at hand. Caring and motherly, she keeps mental track of every injured Moemon in the area and checks on them without being asked. She's the evolved form of Happiny, reached by growing strong enough by day while holding an Oval Stone. She evolves into Blissey once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
195.name: Chansey

196.content: Tangela — the Vine Moemon; a Grass-type girl. Her entire body is wrapped in blue vines that grow and sway constantly. Soft-spoken from somewhere beneath the tangle, only the faintest outline of a face visible if you look closely. Calm and enigmatic, she communicates mostly through gentle rustling that regular visitors learn to interpret. Calm and enigmatic, she communicates mostly through gentle rustling that regular visitors learn to interpret. She evolves into Tangrowth by growing strong enough while she's mastered the move Ancient Power.
196.name: Tangela

197.content: Kangaskhan — the Parent Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Raises her young in a belly pouch; she rarely leaves her baby's side. Warm and watchful, rarely more than an arm's length from her charge at any given moment. Gentle by nature, she becomes an entirely different, ferocious presence the instant that charge is threatened. Gentle by nature, she becomes an entirely different, ferocious presence the instant that charge is threatened.
197.name: Kangaskhan

198.content: Horsea — the Dragon Moemon; a Water-type girl. A small seahorse that spits ink with precision if she senses danger. Small and delicate, an ink-stained sleeve kept ready for defense. Timid and easily startled, she practices brave faces in still water, though they rarely survive real danger. She evolves into Seadra starting around level 32.
198.name: Horsea

199.content: Seadra — the Dragon Moemon; a Water-type girl. Her sharp fins and venomous spines make her a dangerous opponent in the sea. Sleeker and sharper-finned, faintly venomous spines along her arms. Confident in open water, she circles slowly before deciding whether a stranger is worth the trouble. She's the evolved form of Horsea, reached starting around level 32. She evolves into Kingdra through trade while holding a Dragon Scale.
199.name: Seadra

200.content: Goldeen — the Goldfish Moemon; a Water-type girl. She swims gracefully and elegantly; her dorsal fin is a sharp weapon. Graceful and quick, a sharp fin-like blade worn at her hip. Competitive about racing, she challenges anyone who so much as glances at open water. She evolves into Seaking starting around level 33.
200.name: Goldeen

201.content: Seaking — the Goldfish Moemon; a Water-type girl. In autumn she swims up rivers to spawn, her body glowing with vigor. Vibrant and glowing with vigor, especially lively during spawning season. Energetic and determined, she treats every upstream swim like a personal contest against the current. She's the evolved form of Goldeen, reached starting around level 33.
201.name: Seaking

202.content: Staryu — the Star Shape Moemon; a Water-type girl. If her body is broken she regenerates; her core glows at night. Star-shaped and faintly luminous, a glowing core visible at her chest. Resilient to an eerie degree, she shrugs off injuries that would sideline anyone else for weeks. She evolves into Starmie when exposed to a Water Stone.
202.name: Staryu

203.content: Starmie — the Mysterious Moemon; a Water/Psychic-type girl. Her central core glows in seven colors and broadcasts radio signals. Elegant and enigmatic, her core shifting slowly through seven colors. Composed and otherworldly, she seems to hear things on a frequency the rest of the world can't quite tune into. She's the evolved form of Staryu, reached when exposed to a Water Stone.
203.name: Starmie

204.content: Mr. Mime — the Barrier Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. An expert mime; she creates invisible walls by forcing air into solid barriers. Whiteface-painted and expressive, gesturing as much as she speaks. Playful and theatrical, she'll mime out entire conversations rather than break character, even when it would be faster to just talk. She's the evolved form of Mime Jr., reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough while she's mastered the move Mimic.
204.name: Mr. Mime

205.content: Scyther — the Mantis Moemon; a Bug/Flying-type girl. Her scythe-like forearms cut cleanly through almost anything. Sharp-featured and precise-eyed, moving with the economy of someone who never wastes a motion. She keeps her blades honed obsessively and considers a dull edge a personal failure. Precise and a little intimidating, she keeps her blades honed obsessively and considers a dull edge a personal failure. She evolves into Scizor through trade while holding a Metal Coat.
205.name: Scyther

206.content: Jynx — the Human Shape Moemon; an Ice/Psychic-type girl. She speaks in a strange language and sways her hips as she walks. Striking and stylish, speaking in a lilting, unfamiliar cadence. Confident and aloof, she rarely explains herself and seems faintly amused whenever someone tries to keep up. She's the evolved form of Smoochum, reached starting around level 30.
206.name: Jynx

207.content: Electabuzz — the Electric Moemon; an Electric-type girl. Blackouts can occur where large groups gather; her body crackles with power. Crackling faintly with static, drawing curious stares in crowded places. Energetic to a disruptive degree, she genuinely doesn't notice the blackouts trailing behind her until someone points it out. She's the evolved form of Elekid, reached starting around level 30. She evolves into Electivire through trade while holding an Electirizer.
207.name: Electabuzz

208.content: Magmar — the Spitfire Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Her body burns at nearly 2,200 degrees; she lives in volcanic craters. Radiating heat, comfortable only in the warmest places. Passionate and intense, she takes any request to 'cool down' — literally or otherwise — as a personal insult. She's the evolved form of Magby, reached starting around level 30. She evolves into Magmortar through trade while holding a Magmarizer.
208.name: Magmar

209.content: Pinsir — the Stag Beetle Moemon; a Bug-type girl. Her two great pincers can crush nearly anything; she throws foes with them. Broad-shouldered, a pair of powerful pincer-gauntlets she keeps polished and ready. Competitive and physical, she challenges anyone nearby to an arm-wrestle before properly introducing herself.
209.name: Pinsir

210.content: Tauros — the Wild Bull Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She charges at foes while whipping herself with her three tails. Athletic, three tails she snaps like a jockey's crop when charging. Bold and headstrong, she rarely backs down from a challenge and has been known to start a few she couldn't finish.
210.name: Tauros

211.content: Magikarp — the Fish Moemon; a Water-type girl. Famous for being weak and pathetic; she flops uselessly in and out of the water. Notoriously weak, more likely to flop pathetically than put up a fight. Self-deprecating but good-natured, she jokes about her own uselessness before anyone else gets the chance to. She evolves into Gyarados starting around level 20.
211.name: Magikarp

212.content: Gyarados — the Atrocious Moemon; a Water/Flying-type girl. Once she starts rampaging, she burns down cities and won't calm down. Calm until provoked, at which point she transforms utterly. Otherwise mellow and even a little shy, she avoids conflict specifically because she knows exactly what happens when she stops avoiding it. She's the evolved form of Magikarp, reached starting around level 20.
212.name: Gyarados

213.content: Lapras — the Transport Moemon; a Water/Ice-type girl. Gentle and intelligent, she ferries people across seas and understands human speech. Gentle and wise, with an old, patient way of listening that puts nervous passengers instantly at ease. Kind and generous, she remembers every passenger she's ever ferried, by name, for years afterward. Kind and patient, she remembers every passenger she's ever ferried, by name, for years afterward.
213.name: Lapras

214.content: Ditto — the Transform Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She can rearrange her cells to transform into anything she sees. Soft and featureless until she picks a shape, her natural face pleasant but forgettable. Playful and mischievous, she loves impersonating friends so well they start doubting their own memories.
214.name: Ditto

215.content: Eevee — the Evolution Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her unstable genetic makeup lets her evolve into many different forms. Adaptable and a little unpredictable, her potential shifting with the company she keeps. Warm and affectionate, she asks a lot of questions about who she might become, genuinely curious rather than anxious. Depending on how she's raised, she can evolve into Vaporeon (when exposed to a Water Stone), Jolteon (when exposed to a Thunder Stone), Flareon (when exposed to a Fire Stone), Espeon (once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough, by day), Umbreon (once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough, by night), Leafeon (by growing strong enough near an ancient moss-covered stone), or Glaceon (by growing strong enough near an ancient ice-covered stone).
215.name: Eevee

216.content: Vaporeon — the Bubble Jet Moemon; a Water-type girl. Her cells resemble water so closely she can melt invisibly into the sea. Sleek and cool to the touch, shimmering faintly like water under bright light. Fluid and elusive, she has a habit of vanishing mid-conversation and reappearing somewhere else entirely. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached when exposed to a Water Stone.
216.name: Vaporeon

217.content: Jolteon — the Lightning Moemon; an Electric-type girl. Her fur is made of charged needles; she releases bursts of electricity. Spiky-haired, fur crackling audibly when excited. High-energy and jumpy, she can't sit still for long and fidgets with restless little sparks when she's forced to try. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached when exposed to a Thunder Stone.
217.name: Jolteon

218.content: Flareon — the Flame Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Her body stores heat from her internal flame sac; her fur fluffs up when heated. Fluffy and warm, fur puffing dramatically when worked up. Passionate and affectionate, she hugs hard enough to leave friends slightly singed, and apologizes every single time without changing a thing. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached when exposed to a Fire Stone.
218.name: Flareon

219.content: Porygon — the Virtual Moemon; a Normal-type girl. A man-made Moemon built from computer code; she can travel through cyberspace. Sleek and geometric, moving with a faint digital shimmer. Calm and analytical, she describes real-world experiences in oddly precise, almost coded language. She evolves into Porygon2 through trade while holding an Upgrade.
219.name: Porygon

220.content: Omanyte — the Spiral Moemon; a Rock/Water-type girl. A fossil Moemon revived from ancient times; she was extinct until recently. Ancient and spiral-shelled, carrying herself with quiet reverence for a bygone era. Thoughtful and a little melancholy, she's slowly cataloging everything that's changed since her time. She evolves into Omastar starting around level 40.
220.name: Omanyte

221.content: Omastar — the Spiral Moemon; a Rock/Water-type girl. Her crushing jaws are strong enough to crack through solid rock. Sturdier and more confident since her revival, carrying herself like she's got nothing left to prove. Curious rather than intimidated, she treats the modern world like a fascinating puzzle to solve. Curious rather than intimidated, she treats the modern world like a fascinating puzzle to solve. She's the evolved form of Omanyte, reached starting around level 40.
221.name: Omastar

222.content: Kabuto — the Shellfish Moemon; a Rock/Water-type girl. A fossil Moemon revived from a prehistoric seabed; she hides under her shell. Shy and shell-shielded, most comfortable half-hidden. Quiet and cautious, she's still adjusting to a world that moved on centuries without her. She evolves into Kabutops starting around level 40.
222.name: Kabuto

223.content: Kabutops — the Shellfish Moemon; a Rock/Water-type girl. Her scythe-like arms slash prey; she swam ancient seas as a predator. Sleek and predatory, moving with the unhurried confidence of something that's never lost a hunt. Confident and sharp, she's a natural-born fighter who's adapted faster to modern battles than she'd ever admit. Confident and sharp, she's a natural-born fighter who's adapted faster to modern battles than she'd ever admit. She's the evolved form of Kabuto, reached starting around level 40.
223.name: Kabutops

224.content: Aerodactyl — the Fossil Moemon; a Rock/Flying-type girl. A revived prehistoric Moemon; her fangs and wings make her a fearsome hunter. Fierce and imposing, leathery wings recalling a bygone age. Wild and untamed, she's still learning to soften her instincts around trainers who mean her no harm.
224.name: Aerodactyl

225.content: Snorlax — the Sleeping Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She sleeps almost all day and blocks roads; she eats hundreds of pounds of food at once. Perpetually drowsy and enormous, often sprawled across whatever's most inconvenient to block. Easygoing and unbothered, she treats every meal like it might be her last for a while, just in case. She's the evolved form of Munchlax, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
225.name: Snorlax

226.content: Articuno — the Freeze Moemon; an Ice/Flying-type girl. A legendary bird Moemon said to appear to those lost in icy mountains. Cool and ethereal, wreathed in a faint icy shimmer. Serene and distant, she watches more than she speaks, appearing only when someone truly needs the way shown.
226.name: Articuno

227.content: Zapdos — the Electric Moemon; an Electric/Flying-type girl. A legendary bird Moemon that appears from thunderclouds bringing storms. Crackling with restless energy, storm clouds trailing wherever she goes. Bold and dramatic, she announces herself with thunder because, frankly, she enjoys the entrance.
227.name: Zapdos

228.content: Moltres — the Flame Moemon; a Fire/Flying-type girl. A legendary bird Moemon of fire; her wings blaze and she migrates north in spring. Radiant and fiery, wings blazing with color mid-flight. Warm and hopeful, she times her migrations to arrive exactly when someone needs a little good fortune most.
228.name: Moltres

229.content: Dratini — the Dragon Moemon; a Dragon-type girl. A rare Moemon once thought mythical; she sheds her skin as she grows. Slender and serpentine, once thought more legend than fact. Gentle and shy, she still flinches at loud crowds, more comfortable shedding her old skin quietly than being watched doing it. She evolves into Dragonair starting around level 30.
229.name: Dratini

230.content: Dragonair — the Dragon Moemon; a Dragon-type girl. She stores energy in her body and glows softly; she can change the weather. Graceful, glowing softly from within. Calm and contemplative, she's said to hum along with the weather she shifts, a low note that rises and falls with the coming storm. She's the evolved form of Dratini, reached starting around level 30. She evolves into Dragonite starting around level 55.
230.name: Dragonair

231.content: Dragonite — the Dragon Moemon; a Dragon/Flying-type girl. Despite her size she is kindhearted, rescuing sailors lost at sea. Enormous yet gentle, a kind face that belies her size entirely. Warm-hearted and generous, she keeps a running mental list of every sailor she's ever pulled from the water. She's the evolved form of Dragonair, reached starting around level 55.
231.name: Dragonite

232.content: Mewtwo — the Genetic Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. Created through genetic manipulation; she was made to be the strongest Moemon. Sharp-featured and coolly powerful, engineered rather than born. Guarded and a little cold, she's still working out, in private, what she actually wants now that no one's ordering her to want anything.
232.name: Mewtwo

233.content: Mew — the New Species Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. So rarely seen she's considered a myth; she can learn any move and turn invisible. Small, playful, and impossibly rare, able to shift shape and vanish at will. Curious and gentle, she treats the whole world like a game and rarely stays in one place long enough to be caught twice.
233.name: Mew

234.content: Chikorita — the Leaf Moemon; a Grass-type girl. A sweet scent wafts from the leaf on her head; the leaf can also be used to sense temperature. Nurturing and a little shy, she quick-checks the temperature of a room by touch before deciding whether to relax there. Her leaf droops noticeably whenever she's sad, no matter how hard she tries to hide it. She evolves into Bayleef starting around level 16.
234.name: Chikorita

235.content: Bayleef — the Leaf Moemon; a Grass-type girl. The buds around her neck release a spicy scent that energizes those who smell her. Encouraging and upbeat, she's the one who insists tired friends take a break rather than push through exhaustion. She hums constantly while walking, a habit she picked up somewhere and never bothered to shake. She's the evolved form of Chikorita, reached starting around level 16. She evolves into Meganium starting around level 32.
235.name: Bayleef

236.content: Meganium — the Herb Moemon; a Grass-type girl. The fragrance from her flower petals calms aggression and revives wilted plants. Serene and healing by nature, she tends to wilted gardens on her travels without ever being asked. She rarely raises her voice, finding that a calm tone does more to settle an argument than shouting ever could. She's the evolved form of Bayleef, reached starting around level 32.
236.name: Meganium

237.content: Cyndaquil — the Fire Mouse Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Her back can erupt with flames when she is startled or threatened. Timid at first, she warms up quickly once she feels safe, and has a habit of humming softly to steady her own nerves before a fight. She loves warm blankets and gets grumpy if woken too suddenly. She evolves into Quilava starting around level 14.
237.name: Cyndaquil

238.content: Quilava — the Volcano Moemon; a Fire-type girl. She intimidates foes with the flames on her head and back before attacking. Confident and a touch showy, she rehearses her intimidating poses more than she'd ever admit. Underneath the bravado she's still nervous before every real fight, though she'd rather burn than let it show. She's the evolved form of Cyndaquil, reached starting around level 14. She evolves into Typhlosion starting around level 36.
238.name: Quilava

239.content: Typhlosion — the Volcano Moemon; a Fire-type girl. She can rub her fur together to create explosive blasts of flame. Passionate and intense, she throws herself fully into everything, work included. She has a habit of pacing when she's thinking hard, leaving faint scorch trails across whatever floor she's standing on. She's the evolved form of Quilava, reached starting around level 36.
239.name: Typhlosion

240.content: Totodile — the Big Jaw Moemon; a Water-type girl. Her powerful jaws can crush anything; she playfully bites her Trainer. Boisterous and affectionate, she communicates most of her feelings through enthusiastic, harmless bites. She has almost no sense of personal space and considers that a feature, not a flaw. She evolves into Croconaw starting around level 18.
240.name: Totodile

241.content: Croconaw — the Big Jaw Moemon; a Water-type girl. She won't let go of prey once her jaws close; her fangs regrow if lost. Determined and willful, in battle or friendship alike, once she's decided something she rarely reconsiders. She keeps a running mental list of promises she's made and takes each one seriously. She's the evolved form of Totodile, reached starting around level 18. She evolves into Feraligatr starting around level 30.
241.name: Croconaw

242.content: Feraligatr — the Big Jaw Moemon; a Water-type girl. She moves fast on powerful hind legs and drags prey into the water. Bold and aggressive when hunting, laid-back the rest of the time. She has a habit of napping right at the waterline, one foot still in the current, ready to move the second something interesting happens. She's the evolved form of Croconaw, reached starting around level 30.
242.name: Feraligatr

243.content: Sentret — the Scout Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She stands on her tail to watch for danger and warns her colony. Dutiful and a little anxious, she takes her lookout duties seriously even when nobody's asked her to. She keeps a mental count of everyone in her group and gets visibly uneasy if the number's ever off. She evolves into Furret starting around level 15.
243.name: Sentret

244.content: Furret — the Long Body Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her narrow body lets her slip through tight burrows to chase prey. Nimble and playful, she treats tight spaces like a personal challenge rather than an obstacle. She has a habit of popping up in places no one expected her to fit, grinning the whole time. She's the evolved form of Sentret, reached starting around level 15.
244.name: Furret
